findings.title: Redundant screen filter after active_entity_list
findings.summary: Routine `update_position_component` rechecks `entity_screen_id` against `current_screen_id` after iterating `active_entity_list`, which already encodes current-screen membership.

patch.reason: Remove redundant current_screen_id filter after active_entity_list.

findings.title: Redundant entity_active check after active_entity_list
findings.summary: Routine `update_sprite_component` rechecks `entity_active` after iterating `active_entity_list`, which already excludes inactive entities.

patch.reason: Remove redundant entity_active filter after active_entity_list.

findings.title: Redundant screen filter after active_entity_list
findings.summary: Routine `update_input_component` rechecks `entity_screen_id` against `current_screen_id` after iterating `active_entity_list`, which already encodes current-screen membership.

patch.reason: Remove redundant current_screen_id filter after active_entity_list.

findings.title: Redundant screen filter after active_entity_list
findings.summary: Routine `update_gravity_component` rechecks `entity_screen_id` against `current_screen_id` after iterating `active_entity_list`, which already encodes current-screen membership.

patch.reason: Remove redundant current_screen_id filter after active_entity_list.

findings.title: Deadly flag recomputed inside tile interaction
findings.summary: Tile interaction recomputes deadly state late in the frame. This overlaps with earlier deadly/collision passes. A prior `update_deadly_tiles_component` pass already runs earlier in `update_all_entities`, so this block can be removed.

patch.reason: Remove duplicate deadly recomputation in check_tile_interaction; rely on earlier update_deadly_tiles_component pass.

findings.title: HUD score update followed by full HUD render
findings.summary: Routine `check_tile_interaction` updates score digits and then forces a full HUD render. The first call can be removed because force_render_hud already re-applies score digits.

patch.reason: Remove redundant update_hud_score immediately before force_render_hud.
